subject: Retail AI Webinar: playbook, one-pager & demo script alignment
messages:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@retailinsights.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Quick: one-pager + sponsor deliverables for Dec webinar

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for agreeing to be an exec speaker at our December 15 Retail AI webinar. We want to publish a short one-pager promoting the session and also confirm sponsor deliverables (logo, 1-slide blurb).

Could you share a 1-paragraph speaker bio, a one-pager (single PDF preferred), and a 6–8 minute demo script outline we can use for the run-of-show?

We have tight deadlines for the event page: assets due by EOD Tuesday (Dec 8). Michael from the event team is on copy — he will confirm final placement and logo specs.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Anna
Anna Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | Retail Insights
anna@retailinsights.com

Attachment: sponsorship-guidelines.pdf (type: pdf, 120KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@retailinsights.com>, Michael Cho <michael.cho@eventco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: one-pager + sponsor deliverables for Dec webinar

Thanks Anna — we can absolutely get this over before EOD Tuesday.

Plan: 1) one-pager PDF (marketing-friendly), 2) short 6–8 minute demo script (docx), 3) speaker bio + headshot. Laura will own the one-pager and Marissa will drop the demo script. Vanessa, looping you for logo / brand QA.

Deliverables (target timeline):
- Draft one-pager v1: Mon morning (Dec 7) — Laura
- Demo script v1: Mon afternoon — Marissa
- Internal review + slide call: Tue morning (Dec 8) — Karthik/Vanessa
- Final assets uploaded to Drive & sent to Anna: Tue EOD (Dec 8)

Can you confirm the preferred one-pager orientation (single column PDF for site vs. 1-sheet designed PNG)? Also any strict speaker-bio length? We’ll prepare both 100–120 and 40–60 word options.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: placeholder: RI_Webinar_AssetChecklist.xlsx (type: xlsx)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Ruiz <anna@retailinsights.com>, Michael Cho <michael.cho@eventco.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: one-pager + sponsor deliverables for Dec webinar

Karthik / team — attaching draft one-pager (RI_Webinar_OnePager_v1.pdf) and a cleaned 60-word speaker blurb. I leaned into production economics and a short customer example to make it tangible.

Highlights:
- Headline: "Reduce inference costs, scale retail search personalization"
- 3 bullets: latency, cost, operational controls (Dedicated, Private options)
- Call-to-action: link to registration + demo snippet timestamp

Open items for review (please respond inline):
- Tone: more technical or product-focused? I kept it mid-technical for event attendees.
- Visual: I used a 1-column PDF for site; if you prefer a 1-sheet PNG we can export.

Marissa — I left placeholders in the left rail for a 2-slide demo callout.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Content Lead, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: RI_Webinar_OnePager_v1.pdf (type: pdf, 480KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Anna Ruiz <anna@retailinsights.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 16:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: one-pager + sponsor deliverables for Dec webinar

Nice draft, Laura — good framing. I’ve attached demo script v1 (demo-script-v3.docx) with timestamps and a suggested CLI + UI flow. Key asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm which customer snippet we can show live (anonymized) or whether we should use a synthetic dataset?
- Vanessa: need final logo lock and brand placement guidance from Michael; flagged the sponsor-logo-guidelines.png in the Drive.

Proposed rehearsal: Tue Dec 8 at 10:00am PST (20–25 minutes). If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a run-book with timing.

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: demo-script-v3.docx (type: docx, 28KB)

From: Michael Cho <michael.cho@eventco.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@retailinsights.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: one-pager + sponsor deliverables for Dec webinar

Thanks everyone — all assets look good. Quick notes:
- Logo: please upload high-res PNG and SVG to the shared Drive folder; placement is top-right in the sponsor panel (see sponsor-logo-guidelines.png).
- One-pager: prefer the 1-column PDF you attached (Laura) — we’ll use that for the event page.
- Demo: live customer snippet is fine as long as PII is scrubbed. If not, use the synthetic dataset.
- Rehearsal: Tue Dec 8 10:00am PST confirmed for the speaker run. I’ll add Michael from AV, but the link will be the same.

Final ask: can you upload final assets to Drive and drop a short email to confirm done? We’ll finalize registration page after that.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the session on Dec 15.

Best,
Michael Cho
Senior Events Producer | EventCo

Attachment references: sponsor-logo-guidelines.png (type: png, 95KB); schedule-runbook.xlsx (type: xlsx)
